name: Yodomi Umi no Obore Uta
source:
Gisela, a scylla of unusual beauty for her race, has always longed to be even more beautiful.
One night, she discovers a human singing a mysterious song by the shore.
The human, Aisha, is the most beautiful thing she has ever seen.
Consumed by envy, Gisela wants nothing more than to kill and devour her.
